description: HISVIA Industrial Visual Intelligence System — AI-driven B2B visual decision engine. hero_suitability ≠ visual_quality.

scoring_philosophy.visual_quality: Technical image quality: resolution + composition + clarity + relevance. High for clean product photos.
scoring_philosophy.hero_suitability: Brand narrative value for hero banners. Factory scenes > large equipment > components. Quality ≠ suitability.
scoring_philosophy.example: HD valve PNG: visual_quality=90, hero_suitability=10. Factory photo: visual_quality=75, hero_suitability=90.
